title: Encoded maximization problem
statement: An encoded maximization problem consists of a language of well-formed binary instances, a feasibility relation between binary instances and binary solutions, a rational-valued objective function on instance–solution pairs, and a rational optimum value for each binary instance. For every well-formed instance, each feasible solution has objective value at most the stated optimum.
